rules: Preserve original paths and Git identities; no aesthetic rename.
Existing paths inherit the previously reviewed category unchanged.
New paths receive a reviewed family classification and explicit basis.
Closed-unmerged PRs are not accepted main content.
Run success is not Job-complete success or scientific acceptance.
No deletion or rename is authorized.
